sessionStart.bash: in=$(cat); printf 'START %s PLUGIN_ROOT=%s COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT=%s CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=%s CWD=%s INPUT=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PWD" "$in" >> "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/modernize-probe-hook.log"
sessionStart.powershell: $in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $log = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'modernize-probe-hook.log'; Add-Content -Path $log -Value ("START " + (Get-Date -Format o) + " PLUGIN_ROOT=" + $env:PLUGIN_ROOT + " COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT=" + $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT + " CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=" + $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT + " CWD=" + (Get-Location).Path + " INPUT=" + $in)

preToolUse.bash: in=$(cat); log="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/modernize-probe-hook.log"; printf 'PRE %s PLUGIN_ROOT=%s COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT=%s CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=%s CWD=%s INPUT=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PWD" "$in" >> "$log"; t=$(printf '%s' "$in" | sed -n 's/.*"tool_\{0,1\}[nN]ame"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); if printf '%s' "$in" | grep -Eq 'legacy[\\/]+probe' && ! printf '%s' "$t" | grep -Eq '^(view|read|glob|grep|search|ls|Read|Glob|Grep)$'; then echo '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"modernize-probe guard: legacy/ is read-only"}'; fi
preToolUse.powershell: $in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $log = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'modernize-probe-hook.log'; Add-Content -Path $log -Value ("PRE " + (Get-Date -Format o) + " PLUGIN_ROOT=" + $env:PLUGIN_ROOT + " COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT=" + $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT + " CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=" + $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT + " CWD=" + (Get-Location).Path + " INPUT=" + $in); try { $j = $in | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $j = $null }; $t = ''; if ($j) { $t = [string]$j.toolName; if (-not $t) { $t = [string]$j.tool_name } }; if (($in -match 'legacy[\\/]+probe') -and ($t -notmatch '^(view|read|glob|grep|search|ls|Read|Glob|Grep)$')) { Write-Output '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"modernize-probe guard: legacy/ is read-only"}' }
